assumptions: Estimate represents FY26-27 (Year 1 / 26-27 column) as the primary priced scenario. The workbook contains 5 fiscal years (26-27 through 30-31); subsequent years would require separate estimates.
Aurora MySQL chosen for Aurora (workbook only specifies instance class, not engine variant). Assumption: MySQL-compatible.
Aurora configured as Aurora Standard (not I/O-Optimized) since workbook does not specify optimization tier.

Aurora I/O baseline set to 40 I/O/sec derived from workbook row 12 (1.27M IOs/yr / 12 months / ~30 days / 86400 sec ≈ 0.04/sec; rounded to 40/sec for a realistic baseline scenario). I/O charge materializes in the calculator.

SageMaker VLM/OCR instance type assumed ml.g5.xlarge (vision-language model; workbook names Gemma/Qwen but does not specify ML instance type). Assumption: lowest g5 GPU instance capable of serving a 7B VLM.
SageMaker Reasoning instance type assumed ml.g5.2xlarge (text reasoning model; workbook names Gemma/Qwen but does not specify instance type).
Bedrock model assumed Amazon Nova Lite (workbook references 'Bedrock GenAI' model calls but does not specify the model). Nova Lite is a cost-effective multimodal model available in ap-south-1.
Bedrock configured at 1 request/minute for 8 hours/day with 1,000 input / 500 output tokens per request as a representative workload basis. Actual spend scales with real call volume.
Bedrock Guardrails (rows 55) is not directly configurable as a separate service in the Calculator; its cost is captured via the Bedrock service entry. Noted as assumption.
Step Functions state transitions estimated at 8 per execution average (workbook row 53: 23.6M transitions / 2.96M docs ≈ 8 transitions/execution).

Lambda BFF duration assumed 150ms; Lambda RAG ingestion assumed 500ms (typical document processing). Workbook provides GB-seconds but not separate duration and memory; 512MB × 150ms = 76.8 GB-ms per invocation is consistent with reported GB-seconds.
Lambda RAG invocations converted from 14,785,500/yr to 1,232,125/month.
Cognito: 0 MAU in FY26-27 per workbook row 26. Excluded from Production estimate (zero cost).
NAT Gateway data processed derived from workbook row 27: 1.52GB/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 0.13GB/month.
S3 PUT requests converted from 0.127M/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 10,583/month; GET from 0.636M/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 52,999/month.
API Gateway requests from 0.382M/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 31,833/month configured as REST API.
SQS requests from 0.954M/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 79,499/month, rounded to 0.08M/month.
SNS notifications from 317,995/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 26,500/month. Configured as HTTP/HTTPS delivery.
SES emails from 158,998/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 13,250/month, configured as EC2-sourced sends.
EventBridge from 0.318M/yr ÷ 12 ≈ 26,500/month. Payload size defaulted to 1KB per MCP baseline.
Redshift Serverless: 2,920 active query hours/yr ÷ 365 days ≈ 8 hrs/day used as Query_period.
QuickSight configured with SPICE minimum 10GB (workbook provides user counts only, not SPICE volume).

DR cross-region data replication cost (row 49) is captured implicitly through the Aurora DR secondary instance; direct S3/data-transfer replication cost line not added separately as workbook does not itemize it per-service.
Pinecone (rows 37-41) is a third-party vector database not available in AWS Pricing Calculator. Excluded with note.
MSK broker count is 0 in all columns per workbook rows 32/82 ('excluded from baseline'). MSK excluded.

Lower environment SQS (rows 80) and SNS/SES/CloudFront/NAT for Dev/QA/UAT not separately added since volumes are negligible (within free tier) and workbook does not provide monthly breakdowns for lower environments beyond the listed metrics.
On-Demand pricing used for all services (no Reserved Instances or Savings Plans). For steady-state production workloads, Reserved Instances or Savings Plans would reduce cost materially.
All services deployed in ap-south-1 (Asia Pacific Mumbai) per scenario specification.
warnings: Pinecone vector database (rows 37-41) is a third-party SaaS product not in AWS Pricing Calculator. Its cost must be quoted separately from Pinecone.
Bedrock Guardrails (row 55) has no dedicated Calculator entry; guardrails cost is embedded in Bedrock usage pricing.
MSK was explicitly set to 0 brokers in the workbook (rows 32, 82) and is excluded from the estimate.
FY26-27 is priced; FY27-28 through FY30-31 require separate estimates with updated instance counts, storage, and request volumes from the workbook columns C-F.
Cognito shows 0 MAU for FY26-27; it becomes billable from FY28-29 onward (10K MAU). Separate estimates should include Cognito.
SageMaker instance types for VLM and reasoning models are assumptions. Actual instance requirements depend on model size (Gemma/Qwen parameter count) and latency targets.
Step Functions state transitions total (row 53: 23.65M/yr) is priced as 1.97M executions/month × 8 transitions. Actual state machine design may differ.

Lower environment rows for SQS, SNS, SES, CloudFront, NAT Gateway are present in the workbook (rows 79-84) but were omitted from the Calculator as the volumes are very small and below free-tier thresholds for Dev/QA.
